notes.title: New Impression of Cards of Knight!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33640120/2d20b285f58d7737eb54e8b601dfad6ac76fa668.gif

Hi Everyone!

After few updates, Cards of Knight have many changes and improvement in both gameplay and graphics including:

 Enhance the Knockback Ability of the Knight
 Replace the Mana System by Cooldown System
 Dropping Element Gems From Enemies

Feel free to try it out!

notes.title: Version 0.4.0
notes.content:
New Features

    All Enemies Will Drop Element Gems When Dead
    Player Can Collect Element Gems

notes.title: Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
New Features

    Each Card Cost Cooldown Time When Play	
    Add Cooldown Time Before Drawing a New Battle Card on Hand
    Blue Potion Recover All Cooldown Time by 0.5 seconds


Modifications

    No Any Mana Cost when play a Battle Card
    Remove All Mana Status View
    Change Description of First Tutorial

notes.title: Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
New Features

    Add Tutorial about Freeze Attack


Modifications

    The Knight can prevent Knockback from most of the enemies
    Thunderbolt will hit the nearest enemy instead of a random enemy
    Add more information about the Battle Cards at card description field
    Modify the Position of the Hand Cards
